data.name: Molay
data.gender_notes: Molay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Molay is a Sanskrit and Hindu name for the Sun God. It is a powerful and strong name, symbolizing the light, warmth, and energy of the sun. It is a name for a brave and fearless warrior, one who faces challenges head-on and emerges victorious. The name Molay carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Molay usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Molay is a name connected to the Hindu god Surya, the Sun God. It represents the divine light and energy within us, and the strength and courage to face any challenge or adversity.
data.etymology: Molay belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Molay total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
